effects.a_still_frame_from_the_start_of: A still frame from the start of your video fades out over the live footage, so you see the image dissolve into the actual video. No frames are lost. The tool automatically finds the first non-black frame for you.
effects.the_video_starts_massively_zoome: The video starts massively zoomed-in and rapidly pulls back to full frame, like a camera snap-zoom. Great for high-energy openers. Uses zoompan filter; original video is untouched after the burst ends.
effects.the_video_frame_slides_onto_a_bl: The video frame slides onto a black background from any edge. After the animation the video plays normally at full size.
effects.the_video_rotates_in_from_a_smal: The video rotates in from a small, spinning state and expands to fill the frame. A popular dramatic opener. Achieved via rotate + scale expressions on the first N frames.
effects.the_screen_is_split_horizontally: The screen is split horizontally. Top half slides up and bottom half slides down, revealing the video. The cinematic curtain reveal. Achieved with two crop+overlay layers animating in opposite directions.
effects.the_last_n_seconds_of_your_video: The last N seconds of your video fade smoothly to black. Audio fades out in parallel. Clean and professional.
effects.the_last_frame_of_the_video_is: The last frame of the video is frozen, then slowly zooms out and fades to black. A classic cinematic ending.
effects.a_black_oval_vignette_closes_in_: A black oval vignette closes in from the edges to the centre like a classic iris wipe, beloved in cinema and vintage content.
effects.slam_a_large_emoji_or_short_text: Slam a large emoji or short text onto the video at a specific timestamp with a pop-in scale animation. Set the position (% of frame), appear time, and hold duration.
effects.a_professional_name_title_bar_th: A professional name/title bar that slides up from the bottom. Used for speaker IDs, location captions, product names, and news-style graphics.
effects.burns_a_customisable_call_to_act: Burns a customisable call-to-action reminder onto your video. "Like & Subscribe!", "Follow for more", etc. Animates in with a bounce and fades out cleanly.
effects.burns_a_live_countdown_clock_ont: Burns a live countdown clock onto the video starting at your chosen value. Great for reaction videos, cooking timers, challenges, and live event coverage.
effects.adds_a_youtube_style_thin_progre: Adds a YouTube-style thin progress bar at the top or bottom that fills from left to right as the video plays. Viewers love knowing how far through the video they are.
effects.splits_the_red_green_and_blue_ch: Splits the Red, Green, and Blue channels and offsets them horizontally to create the classic chromatic aberration / cyberpunk glitch look seen everywhere on YouTube. Apply to a section or the entire video.
effects.simulates_a_degraded_vhs_tape_co: Simulates a degraded VHS tape: colour bleed, noise, scanlines, and edge distortion. Popular for nostalgia, horror, lo-fi, and vaporwave aesthetics.
effects.adds_organic_temporal_film_grain: Adds organic, temporal film grain. Used by cinematographers to add texture, hide compression artefacts, and give footage a cinematic / analogue feel.
effects.darkens_the_edges_of_the_frame_d: Darkens the edges of the frame, drawing the eye to the centre. One of the most universally used effects in cinema and YouTube.
effects.simulates_a_burst_of_warm_light_: Simulates a burst of warm light sweeping across the frame, as if a lens flare or light leak was caught on a film camera. Great for transitions and dream-like sequences.
effects.simulates_an_unstabilised_handhe: Simulates an unstabilised handheld camera. Apply to impact moments, action sequences, or jump scares. Amplitude controls jitter size. Frame edges are cropped slightly to hide the shake border.
effects.a_sudden_very_fast_zoom_in_at: A sudden very fast zoom-in at a specific timestamp, synced to an impact, beat drop, or punchline. A favourite for meme edits, gaming highlights, and react content.
effects.a_slow_cinematic_pan_and_zoom_ac: A slow, cinematic pan and zoom across the entire video. Named after the documentary filmmaker. Ideal for drone footage, landscape shots, interview B-roll, and still photo slideshows.
effects.adds_an_extreme_horizontal_or_ve: Adds an extreme horizontal or vertical motion blur over a short window, simulating a fast camera whip pan. Perfect for transitions between scenes, used on YouTube by MrBeast, MKBHD, Linus Tech Tips, and almost every vlogger.
effects.burns_large_white_impact_style_t: Burns large white Impact-style text with black outline onto the video: top caption, bottom caption, or both. The classic meme format used on every reaction and highlight channel.
effects.adds_letterbox_bars_to_simulate_: Adds letterbox bars to simulate a 2.39:1 or 2.35:1 anamorphic widescreen cinema aspect ratio. Optionally animate them sliding in from the edges for a dramatic reveal.
effects.burns_a_persistent_channel_handl: Burns a persistent channel handle / watermark onto the entire video. Supports @ prefixes, emojis, and custom positioning. Essential for short-form content repurposed across platforms.
region_blur.hide_faces_plates_names_or_s: Hide faces, plates, names or screens.
deshaker.frames_averaged_each_way_higher: Frames averaged each way: higher = steadier, floatier camera.
deshaker.how_shaky_the_footage_is_1_a: How shaky the footage is (1 = a little, 10 = very).
color_correct.exposure_tone_white_balanc: Exposure, tone, white balance and colour with a live before/after preview.

advanced_settings.everything_goes_throug: Everything goes through Tor and nothing goes out without it. Some sites block Tor; downloads then retry through fresh Tor circuits.
advanced_settings.proxies_that_sign_you_: Proxies that sign you in automatically with your Windows account (NTLM/Kerberos) need a local helper such as Px or CNTLM; then use its local address here. The password is never put on a command line.
advanced_settings.security_products_such: Security products such as Zscaler, Netskope or a school firewall re-sign websites with their own certificate. It is usually installed on the computer already; if not, ask IT for the file.
advanced_settings.downloads_are_checked_: Downloads are checked against fixed SHA-256 sums, so a mirror can't swap the files.
advanced_settings.the_local_address_only: The local address only helps where the network allows it (several connections, or a VPN with split tunnelling). Where an organisation's VPN sends all traffic through itself, the app doesn't try to get around that.
